name: Old Hookclaw
place: circles the switchbacks below Hollin Toll and lands on whoever is alone on the road
_doc: Stream E (M2). A grey griffin with one hooked talon. Dives on a random player (the circle leads them), a wing gust shoves everyone off the ledge-side of a cone, and at half health it takes to the air: three dives in a row, each re-aimed.

party.solo: Fine for a careful solo player at level 7: the dives are the only real damage.
party.small: Comfortable; the gust can knock a healer away, stand behind it.
party.full: Quick — it dies before the second dive set.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: A shriek echoes off the cliff. Something big blots out the sun.
say.death: Old Hookclaw tumbles down the scree, feathers everywhere.
say.reset: Old Hookclaw climbs back into the thermals.

gust.name: Wing Gust
gust.say: Its wings spread — do not stand in front of it!

triple_dive.name: Triple Stoop
triple_dive.say: {boss} screams and stoops again, and again, and again!

phases.name: On the Wing
phases.say: Old Hookclaw takes to the sky!
